_about: Policyholder questions for the policy search evaluation (ADR 0012). Each template names the clause key that answers it; {guarantee} is replaced by every colloquial name of every guarantee the product mentions. A coverage question about a guarantee the product does not include is answered by its 'not included' clause. Questions are written in everyday words on purpose, avoiding the wording of the conditions where possible. Entries with "set": "terms" are the opposite: keyword searches copied from the conditions, reported apart.

HOME_WATER: una fuga de agua en casa
HOME_THEFT: que entren a robar en mi casa
HOME_GLASS: el cristal roto de una ventana
AUTO_THEFT: que me roben piezas del coche
el robo de la radio del coche
LIABILITY: los daños que cause a otros con el coche
